title: What If a Hippo Moved Into Your Bathtub? #shorts

lines.text: A hippo just moved into your bathtub, and your bathroom is already a swamp!
He weighs up to four and a half tons, so your bathtub lasted about one second.
His red skin goo works like sunscreen, so your white towels are now salmon colored.
And to show who's boss, he flicks his poop around with his tail.
Moral: never share a bathroom with a hippo.

sources: https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/mammals/facts/hippopotamus (hippos weigh up to 4.5 tons; oily red secretion shields skin from sun and germs; males flick dung with their tails to show dominance; up to 22 mph on land; cannot swim or float)
https://www.sciencenews.org/article/red-sweat-hippo-skin-oozes-antibiotic-sunscreen (red-orange secretion absorbs UV, works as sunscreen, inhibits bacteria; not blood)

facts.hedge: bathroom scenario is a comedic what-if; towels 'salmon colored' is the joke
